# Saurav Shrestha

> Saurav Shrestha (also spelled Saurab Shrestha) is a Full Stack Developer
> from Lalitpur, Nepal.

## About
Saurav Shrestha builds end-to-end products: Java and Spring Boot backends
with RESTful APIs, React.js frontends, and MySQL data layers, plus IoT
automation on ESP32 and Arduino (including a self-regulating greenhouse).
Notable work: Poem Sansar (a social platform for poets), a Java book
marketplace with secure sessions and role-based access, and 54.5 hours of
robotics and UI/UX mentoring delivered to students across colleges in Nepal.
